strengths: The exact same sign geometry reads as supported facade hardware in an old-city bookshop and an adaptive-reuse brick cafe without host-specific mesh edits.
Smooth bracket rails, a triangular load path, alternating closed chain links and independent frame members replace the former fused rectangular sign proxy.
Both camera sides show physical raised page surfaces, gold page outlines and a central fold that read as an open-book emblem at the accepted medium distance.
Weathered wood, dark iron and restrained gold remain distinct under both cool/warm lighting topologies without clipped or emissive-looking highlights.
limitations: Accepted for background and medium use only; welds, bolts, hinge pins, chain wear and wood edge damage are insufficient for close or hero-close inspection.
The canonical emblem proves a replaceable two-sided content slot but does not provide arbitrary typography, texture baking, localisation or campaign logo fitting.
The sign is currently static; wind-driven hinge motion, collision stops and chain dynamics are not yet implemented.
Host compatibility assumes a vertical facade with the declared mounting-height range and a clear projecting volume.
notes: Accepted after rejecting V1 because its book mark read as a diamond and V2 because the revised outline still read as a shield. V3 adds two raised page surfaces with contrasting fill, independent outlines and a central fold. Acceptance must independently prove content triangles on both physical faces, opposed face attachments, campaign-replacement semantics, host clearance, exact geometry reuse, distinct pixels and every render gate.
